vocabulary.meaning_en: used for expectations, obligations, plans and what people believe
vocabulary.meaning_ar: من المفترض أن / من المقرر أن
vocabulary.note_ar: في الكلام السريع تُنطق /spəʊstə/ (يسقط صوت u و d) لكن تُكتب دائمًا supposed بحرف d
vocabulary.note_en: In fast speech it sounds like "s'posta" (the u and d drop), but always write supposed with a d.
vocabulary.example: The bus is supposed to arrive at eight.
My expectation was a lower price.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you must do because of your job, a rule or duty

vocabulary.example: It's a common belief that fruit is healthy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you must do because it is your job or responsibility
vocabulary.example: It's the guard's duty to lock the door.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sold at a lower price than usual
vocabulary.example: These shoes are on sale this week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stand in a row and wait
vocabulary.example: People lined up outside the bank.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to sleep later than usual in the morning
an angry feeling when you can't change something
the reason something exists or is used
vocabulary.example: What is the purpose of this button?
The function of a clock is to tell the time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a job or duty that you must take care of
vocabulary.example: Fixing the printer is not my responsibility.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that makes paper copies

fine_lines.title: supposed to: expectation vs obligation vs belief
fine_lines.explanation_ar: التوقع: ما تظنه سيحدث (السعر من المفترض أن يكون مخفّضًا). الالتزام: أقوى، قريب من must، بسبب عمل أو قاعدة (من المفترض أن تكون في العمل الساعة 9). الاعتقاد: ما يقوله الناس (I have heard / people believe).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Expectation: what you think should happen (the price is supposed to be on sale). Obligation: stronger, close to must, because of a job or rule (you're supposed to be at work at 9). Belief: what people say is true (I have heard / people believe).

examples.sentence: It's $20? It's supposed to be on sale!
The bank is supposed to open at 9 a.m.
Oxford is supposed to be a great university.

fine_lines.title: is supposed to vs was supposed to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الحاضر (am/is/are supposed to) للخطة الحالية أو المستقبلية. الماضي (was/were supposed to) يعني غالبًا أن الخطة تغيّرت ولم تحدث.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Present (am/is/are supposed to) is for a plan now or in the future. Past (was/were supposed to) usually means the plan changed and it didn't happen.

examples.sentence: I'm supposed to meet my friend tonight.
I was supposed to meet my friend, but he was sick.

expressions.phrase: What am I supposed to do?
expressions.meaning_en: (1) Frustration: it's not my job! (2) A real question: what is my duty here?
expressions.example: The printer is broken again. What am I supposed to do? I'm not a technician!

expressions.phrase: What is this supposed to do?
expressions.meaning_en: What is the purpose or function of this thing?
expressions.example: What is this button supposed to do?

expressions.phrase: You're supposed to be here at nine.
expressions.meaning_ar: من المفترض أن تكون هنا الساعة التاسعة.
expressions.example: You're late! You're supposed to be here at nine.

expressions.meaning_ar: لم يكن من المتوقع أن تمطر.
expressions.meaning_en: Something different from the plan happened.
expressions.example: We wanted a picnic, but it rained. It wasn't supposed to rain!
It's late. I'm supposed to get going.

grammar.title: Form: be + supposed + to + base verb
grammar.explanation_ar: التركيب: فعل be + supposed + to + المصدر. نغيّر be حسب الفاعل: I am، he/she/it is، we/you/they are. المضارع يُستخدم للحاضر والمستقبل. لا تحذف حرف d عند الكتابة.
grammar.explanation_en: Form: be + supposed + to + base verb. Change be for the subject: I am, he/she/it is, we/you/they are. The present form is used for now and the future. Never drop the d in writing.
examples: I am supposed to meet my friend for dinner.
She is supposed to call me tonight.
They are supposed to arrive tomorrow.

grammar.title: Past: was/were supposed to = the plan changed
grammar.explanation_ar: was/were supposed to + المصدر: كانت هناك خطة لكنها تغيّرت أو لم تحدث.
grammar.explanation_en: was/were supposed to + base verb: there was a plan, but it changed or didn't happen.
examples: I was supposed to be home by now. (I'm not home.)
You were supposed to be here an hour ago.

grammar.title: Negative: be + not + supposed to
grammar.explanation_ar: نضع not مع فعل be وليس مع الفعل الأخير: isn't supposed to / wasn't supposed to. في الماضي المنفي: ما حدث لم يكن متوقعًا.
grammar.explanation_en: Put not with be, not with the main verb: isn't supposed to / wasn't supposed to. Past negative: what happened was not expected.
examples: You're not supposed to smoke in here. (rule)
The test wasn't supposed to be hard.
It wasn't supposed to rain today.

grammar.title: Three meanings
grammar.explanation_ar: (1) التوقع: ما نظن أنه يجب أن يكون. (2) الالتزام: واجب أو قاعدة (قريب من must). (3) الاعتقاد: ما سمعناه أو ما يعتقده الناس.
grammar.explanation_en: (1) Expectation: what we think should be. (2) Obligation: a duty or rule (close to must). (3) Belief: what we have heard or what people believe.
examples: The shop is supposed to be cheaper. (expectation)
Workers are supposed to wear helmets. (obligation)
This restaurant is supposed to be very good. (belief)

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling.
questions.explanation_en: be + supposed (with d) + to + base verb.

questions.question: "I was supposed to visit my uncle." What probably happened?
choices: I will visit him for sure.
The plan changed; I didn't visit him.
questions.explanation_ar: was supposed to تعني غالبًا أن الخطة تغيّرت.
questions.explanation_en: Was supposed to usually means the plan changed.

questions.question: "Workers are supposed to wear helmets." This is ___.
"People say this restaurant is excellent." = "This restaurant ___ excellent."
Make it negative: "You are supposed to park here."
choices: You are supposed not park here.
You don't supposed to park here.
You aren't supposed to park here.
You are supposed to don't park here.

questions.question: "What is this supposed to do?" asks about ___.
questions.explanation_en: It asks about the purpose or function.

questions.question: She ___ supposed to call me tonight.
It's $20! It's supposed to be $15. This shows ___.
What does "sleep in" mean?
questions.explanation_ar: sleep in = ينام حتى وقت متأخر.
questions.explanation_en: Sleep in = sleep later than usual.

questions.question: "What am I supposed to do? It's not my job!" shows ___.
